headline: AI moved into the manager's loop: the review, the 1:1, and the action plan

themes.title: The 1:1 becomes review evidence
themes.evidence: Betterworks turns Zoom 1:1 transcripts into recaps and goal updates (Sep 15); Leapsome turns them into goals and praise (Sep 16); 15Five's AI-drafted reviews went GA (Sep 17).
themes.so_what: meeting capture now feeds review AI. What feeds Ask AI from our 1-on-1s?

themes.title: Review scoring gets weighted
themes.evidence: Lattice blends ratings, goals, and competencies into one normalized score with half-point scales (Sep 30); Culture Amp pulls goals and custom demographics into reviews (Sep 29).
themes.so_what: weighting and competencies in reviews are table stakes; check decimal-scale parity.

themes.title: AI closes the survey-to-action loop
themes.evidence: Leapsome auto-drafts survey action plans (Sep 10); Culture Amp's AI probes answers mid-survey (Sep 8) and flags sensitive comments (Sep 23).
themes.so_what: our AI action planning has a direct match; win on anonymity and follow-through.

themes.title: People data opens to outside AI
themes.evidence: Perceptyx put survey data and action plans into Copilot, Claude, and ChatGPT via MCP, with attrition models in pilot (Sep 29); BambooHR and Lattice widened MCP access.
themes.so_what: expect an MCP question in evaluations, and a Retention Radar comparison.

watch_next: 15Five's MCP and 1:1 Meeting Assistant (Oct 8), Workday Rising agents (Oct 13), Lattice Meetings and AI calibration (fall roadmap).
source: Source: QW CI report for 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30 (reports/2026-09-CI-Report.md). Vendor release notes, help centers, and press; every item dated and linked there.
notes:
Talk track (about 90 seconds)

1) The 1:1 becomes review evidence.
- Betterworks Conversational Intelligence (GA 2026-09-15): Zoom or uploaded 1:1 transcripts become a shared recap, a private prep brief, and suggested action items and goal updates. https://support.betterworks.com/hc/en-us/articles/48817244144781-Conversational-Intelligence-NextGen
- Leapsome Smart Follow-Ups (2026-09-16): one-tap goals, praise, and requests from meeting transcripts. https://www.leapsome.com/app/#/product-updates
- 15Five AI-Assisted Reviews GA (2026-09-17): drafts grounded in evidence from 15Five and connected tools, including 1-on-1 notes; Amaya now analyzes review open text (2026-09-25). https://success.15five.com/hc/en-us/articles/50989471559067-What-s-new-in-15Five-Product-releases

2) Review scoring gets weighted.
- Lattice (2026-09-30): goals and competencies in weighted overall scores, auto-normalized across scales and fed to calibration; opt-in 0.1 rating increments. https://lattice.com/blog/september-2026-product-updates
- Culture Amp (2026-09-29): Goals in Reviews (AI Coach uses goal context) and custom demographics in review cycles. https://updates.cultureamp.com/158621-goals-in-reviews-now-available

3) AI closes the survey-to-action loop.
- Leapsome AI-generated survey action plans (2026-09-10), with suggested owners and timelines. https://www.leapsome.com/app/#/product-updates
- Culture Amp AI Follow-Ups (2026-09-08) and Sensitive Comment Management (2026-09-23). https://updates.cultureamp.com/156617-uncover-the-why-behind-your-data-with-ai-follow-ups
- Also: Qualtrics action-plan reminders via email and Teams (2026-09-02); Viva Glint Copilot comment rewrite (end of September; off by default; rewritten comments are not flagged in reports).

4) People data opens to outside AI.
- Perceptyx Anywhere (2026-09-29): GA MCP server and APIs bring survey results, nudges, and action plans into Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or custom agents under existing confidentiality thresholds; attrition-predicting models are in pilot with design partners. https://blog.perceptyx.com/perceptyx-launches-perceptyx-anywhere
- BambooHR MCP server and Claude connector, including goal tools (beta, 2026-09-14); Lattice MCP in Glean (2026-09-30). Culture Amp launched MCP on 2026-08-24, so Lattice, Culture Amp, and Leapsome all have one now.

Also notable (not on the slide)
- Development: Betterworks AI development plans with LMS course recommendations and role matching (2026-09-15); PerformYard's new Talent Development suite with AI coaching, competencies, and comp (2026-09-01).
- Recognition & Rewards: BambooHR added AI-suggested, points-based recognition in Slack (beta, 2026-09-14). An HRIS our customers may already own now does recognition plus rewards.

Method: all 21 tracked competitors scanned; 74 verified in-window items (8 High, 21 Medium, 45 Low). Full report with every source: reports/2026-09-CI-Report.md.
